\begin{document}
Let $x$ be real. The scattering phase obeys
\begin{equation}
\tan^{-1} x = \frac{\cos x}{\sin x}
\label{eq:v1}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\sinh^{-1} x \, \sinh x = 1
\label{eq:v2}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\frac{d\,\tan^{-1} x}{dx} = -\frac{1}{\sin^2 x}
\label{eq:v3}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
